source.title: ADHD-01 Advanced Dial-Home Device Project
source.description: Doing something creative while channeling my inner Samantha Carter! The ADHD-01 (Mark 1 Advanced Dial-Home Device) project is an unusual home automation controller using a rotary dial as an input device, and Nixie tubes for displaying the parameters and values. The project is moved from NodeMCU / ESP8266 to Raspberry Pi Pico W with a lot of code still to be done. The hardware as of now is working pretty nice - watch these lovely Nixies glow... Contrary to what they say, resistance is NOT futile! 0:00 Intro 1:15 Unboxing 2:18 The Story Behind ADHD 4:07 Purpose and Pitfalls 7:26 Latched BCD Nixie Control 9:03 About These Nixies 10:45 RF Shielding Shenanigans 13:00 Further Discombobulation 17:20 Mechanical Modding 22:46 Pilot Lamp Fix 23:45 Interlude 24:40 Post-Rewire 26:40 Assembly 34:55 Launch! Hackaday project page: https://hackaday.io/project/188537-advanced-dial-home-device Support me on my Patreon page at https://www.patreon.com/KeritechElectronics Instagram - https://www.instagram.com/KeriSzafir Hackaday - https://hackaday.io/keritech
